revision_note: 裁决 B（support 族）：四个 SUP code 全部保留，include/exclude 重写为互斥规则，并增加强制优先级：BELLY_LIFT > weight PRESSURE_OFFLOAD > BACK > relief PRESSURE_OFFLOAD > GENERAL。code 集合不变；现有 coded/ALL.jsonl 是 v1.0 产物，未重新编码。 提案 v1.2（未冻结、未应用）：补齐 BELLY_LIFT 的 "holds my belly up" 语序，并给 step 4 的 relief/ease/take away 增加 pain/pressure 目标词约束。

resolution_rules.condition: lift / hold up + belly / bump / bundle / baby
weight or load transfer: weight off, takes the weight, weight is lifted, pressure off
explicit back or waist reference, and no step-2 weight/load transfer
relief / ease / take away + pain or pressure in the same span, and no back reference
generic support only: no body part, weight/load, or belly lift

resolution_note: SUP 族按 step 升序判断；第一个命中的 code 是该 evidence span 的唯一 SUP code。step 2（weight/load）优先于 step 3（BACK），因此 'the weight off my pelvis and lower back' 归 SUP.PRESSURE_OFFLOAD。 并列谓语（例如 "It lifts my bump nicely, and my lower back pain has eased"）按谓语切成独立 span，各自走优先级；不得用整句 span 只取 step 1。
example_note: positive_example = an utterance that should receive this code with positive polarity. negative_example = a near-miss that must NOT receive this code because it falls under the taxonomy exclude rule. Both are [derived] from the frozen lexicon; the frozen module has no examples of its own. Definitions are verbatim from the frozen module.

aspects.label: 总体支撑
aspects.definition: 对支撑效果的评价；仅在没有部位、没有重量转移、没有托起肚子语义时使用。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] This belly band gives me the support I need to stay on my feet.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] The fabric feels soft and cozy against my skin.
aspects.exclude: back pain / lower back / back support / my back → BACK；weight off / take the weight / weight is lifted → PRESSURE；lift my belly / hold up bump / holding up her bundle → BELLY_LIFT；comfortable / soft → COM.*

aspects.label: 背部支撑
aspects.definition: 对下背、腰部支撑或该部位疼痛缓解的评价。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] The back support is firm and my lower back pain has eased.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] The weight off my lower back is unreal.
aspects.include: back pain, backache, lower back, back support, my back
aspects.exclude: weight off / take the weight / weight is lifted（即使同句有 lower back）→ PRESSURE；无背部指向的 support → GENERAL；姿势/运动

aspects.label: 压力卸载
aspects.definition: 对重量被卸掉、负载/压力被转移，或疼痛/压力得到缓解的评价。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It takes the weight off my hips so I can stand longer.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] The straps are easy to tighten.
aspects.include: weight off, takes the weight, weight is lifted, pressure off, relieve/ease/take away pain or pressure
aspects.exclude: 仅描述松紧；单纯 support → GENERAL/BACK；点名 lower back/back pain 且无 weight/load 语义 → BACK；lift/hold up belly → BELLY_LIFT；weightless 仅描述带子本身轻 → APP.LOW_PROFILE/COM.*；缓解来自其他物品/行为 → 不标

aspects.label: 腹部托举
aspects.definition: 明确描述把肚子托起来、兜住或托举。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It lifts my belly and holds up my bump nicely.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] It gives good overall support.
aspects.include: lift my belly, lift your belly, hold up bump, holding up her little bundle, 托起肚子, hold my belly up, holding her bump up
aspects.exclude: 仅说 support → GENERAL；仅说 weightless → PRESSURE/COM.*

aspects.label: 尺码准确
aspects.definition: 尺码是否与标注/预期一致。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] I ordered my usual medium and it is true to size.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] Which size should I order at 30 weeks?
aspects.include: true to size, runs small/large, size up/down

aspects.label: 体型适配
aspects.definition: 腹型、躯干、身高、plus size 对适配的影响。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] As a plus size mom with a short torso, this still fits well.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] I bought a large because the size chart said so.
aspects.include: short/long torso, plus size, body shape

aspects.label: 孕期增长区间
aspects.definition: 随孕周/肚子增长是否仍可用。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It still fits now that my bump has grown at 34 weeks.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] I wore it once for a short walk.
aspects.include: as bump grows, later pregnancy, third trimester

aspects.label: 覆盖范围
aspects.definition: 支撑带覆盖面积是否足够。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] The coverage is wide enough to cover my whole lower belly.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] The black color matches everything I wear.

aspects.label: 带体/绑带设计
aspects.definition: 绑带、魔术贴、扣件等结构。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] The velcro straps let me set the band exactly where I want it.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] It supports my back well.

aspects.label: 穿脱难度
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It is easy to put on and take off by myself.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] I bought it during my second trimester.
aspects.include: put on, take off, get on

aspects.label: 松紧调节
aspects.definition: 可调节范围与张力是否合适。
aspects.positive_example: [derived] I can adjust the tension so it is snug but not too tight.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] The band has no buckles or straps to adjust.

aspects.label: 保持位置
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It stays in place and does not slip down when I walk.

aspects.label: 绑带位置

aspects.positive_example: [derived] The straps sit comfortably and do not dig into my ribs.
aspects.negative_example: [derived] It feels a little tight around my waist.

aspects.label: 柔软触感

aspects.label: 透气与发热

aspects.label: 皮肤摩擦
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It does not rub or leave a rash on my skin.

aspects.label: 局部压迫
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It does not dig into my sides or leave marks.

aspects.label: 长时间穿着

aspects.negative_example: [derived] I wore it for ten minutes to try it on.
aspects.include: all day, for hours, long wear

aspects.label: 总体舒适
aspects.positive_example: [derived] It is comfortable overall.

aspects.negative_example: [derived] I wear it over a dress at home.

aspects.label: 穿着方式
